desc: Formalize strong-connectivity condition: SCC iff every cut k has a backward edge (b≤k<w); cuts with D_k>0 are auto-covered, so only prefixes with D_k≤0 matter ("closed prefix" bad events).

Derive counting formula: inclusion-exclusion over closed prefixes gives recurrence G(p) = Fall(γ_p,β_p) − Σ G(p')·Fall(γ_p−β_{p'},β_p−β_{p'}); answer = G(2N). Verified on samples 1 and 2 by hand (BWBW→1, BWWBWBWB→0).
Implement solution in Python: prefix balances, candidate list, CDQ D&C + NTT convolution for the recurrence, mod 998244353; output G(2N).

Validate on all three samples (1, 0, 240792), cross-check vs brute force on 300 random small strings, and performance-test at N=2×10^5 (random, alternating, block shapes; block case equals N! as expected).
Produce the final submission program: validated solve(S) logic with stdin reading (read N, read S, print solve(S)), enclosed in the required delimiters.
